reasoning: A clear document outline containing a single eighth note, universally understood as either an audio file (MP3/WAV) or printed sheet music. It fits tasks centered on managing digital sound files or musical scores, though general listening or instrument practice tasks are better served by a standalone music note, headphones, or instrument icon.
